notes.title: Ranked rooms and account linking tool update
notes.notes:
Today we have released rank limited rooms.  There are new rooms with a minimum requirement (e.g. "Cpl+" will only be visible if you have Corporal or higher rank).
These will allow you to play with players at a similar level to your own progress, which should make for more exciting battles with less drop-outs by casual guest accounts.
We are hoping this new feature will be enjoyed, and we welcome any and all feedback!

The eagerly awaited Account Linking Tool has been completed and will enter QA testing tomorrow.  We are currently on track to launch it by the end of the week.
Players with WebGL accounts will be able to link them to Steam and play with their favourite old character.  Any experience, z-cash, or Slugs gained or purchased on Steam will be added to the linked account, however equipment will not be copied across due to technical limitations with the database structure.

notes.title: Mac release of Freefall Tournament
notes.notes:
Today we have enabled the Mac version of Freefall Tournament!

The server system will also provide a more reliable game service when one of the regional servers has problems.  The game will now attempt to connect you even if the most local server is not available.
This may result in higher ping times than you would normally expect when you are rerouted to a more distant server because your local server is down.
We always attempt to repair any server problems within a few minutes of the problem occurring, so if you find the increased ping time is unacceptable - please wait a few minutes then try again to change region back to your local server.
